messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Cyclobenzaprine is a prescription muscle relaxant used short-term to relieve muscle spasms caused by sprains, strains, and injuries, including low back and neck pain. It is used together with rest and physical therapy to help relieve the pain, tenderness, and limited movement caused by muscle spasm. 1,2
Cyclobenzaprine is also used to treat fibromyalgia in adults, where it can help reduce pain. For fibromyalgia, it is taken as a sublingual (under the tongue) tablet at bedtime under the brand name Tonmya. In clinical trials, Tonmya significantly reduced fibromyalgia pain compared with placebo over 14 weeks, and close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain. 3
The Flexeril brand has been discontinued, but cyclobenzaprine is available as generic tablets and as the brand-name products Amrix (extended-release capsules) and Fexmid. 2,4
Triplet: ["Tonmya", "achieves improvement in", "at least 30% improvement in pain"]

The relation 'achieves improvement in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug leads to the specified improvement in the medical condition or symptom.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the therapeutic or physiological effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'increases level of': The subject drug increases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
E. 'helps reduce': The subject drug is used to decrease or lessen the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
